families.label: Acids and acidic formulations
families.note: Acid-resistance or dilution-related wording; acidity alone does not establish skin corrosion.

families.label: Alkalis and alkaline formulations
families.note: Alkali-resistant packaging and protection fragments; check actual compatibility.

families.label: Organic-solvent-containing products
families.note: Solvent-resistance material fragments; solvent identity and exposure conditions govern suitability.

families.label: Isocyanate-containing products
families.note: Supplemental label candidates; EUH204 applicability and thresholds need legal review.

families.label: Epoxy-resin-containing products
families.note: Supplemental label candidates; EUH205 applicability depends on actual components and rules.

families.label: Oxidising substances or mixtures
families.note: Special fire/storage precautions only when compatible with an existing oxidising classification.

families.label: Organic peroxides
families.note: Thermal/ignition precautions require substance-specific stability and classification review.

families.label: Water-reactive substances
families.note: Avoid-water handling/cleanup candidates gated by an existing H260/H261 classification.

families.label: Metal powders and metallic dusts
families.note: Dust precautions for confirmed metal-powder form; metal fires require expert-specific extinguishing decisions.

families.label: Acid-reactive toxic-gas releasers
families.note: Specific supplemental gas-release label wording only if EUH031 or EUH032 is in the approved classification.

assessments.label: Product-specific water dilution has been independently assessed as suitable
assessments.note: Do not confirm merely because the product belongs to an acid family.
